user.title: Connect your EufyMake E1
user.description: Choose the original files from EufyMake Studio. Files go directly to this Home Assistant instance. Windows profile: %APPDATA%\eufyMake Studio Profile\cache\offline. Choose device_info\device_list.json and user_info\login_info.json. Choose the matching broker CA certificate from the Studio installation (make-us.crt in the original US setup). Keep these files private. Setup verifies the cloud connection; it does not require a local MQTT broker.

printer.title: Select your printer
printer.description: Select the E1 to connect. If connection fails, check internet access and that these are current Studio credentials.

error.invalid_files: The Studio files or CA certificate could not be read. Select the original files again. Supported regions in this preview: US, CA, MX, EU, GB, DE, FR.
error.invalid_auth: Eufy rejected the connection credentials or topic access. Sign in to Studio again and reimport its current files.
error.cannot_connect: Could not establish a verified connection to Eufy. Check internet access, region and Studio CA certificate.
error.wrong_printer: Select the same printer when refreshing this integration’s credentials.
